claims.claim: Customized PS4 big, with 2 pads, 7 games and complete accessories
claims.evidence: Witness only saw two red printed board-game style boxes with text/logos; no PS4 console, controllers/pads, or game discs/cases were shown.

risks.risk: Item may not be a PS4 at all; could be board-game boxes or unrelated packaging, so pricing based on PS4 would be wrong.
risks.proof: A clear photo showing the actual PS4 console (front with logo), plus the two controllers/pads, and the 7 game discs/cases.
risks.if_unproven: Price as board-game boxes only (worst case: incomplete/unknown contents), not as a PS4 bundle.

risks.risk: Even if it is a console bundle, the contents may be incomplete (missing controllers, missing accessories, missing games, or missing inserts).
risks.proof: One video/clip opening everything and showing: both pads/controllers, all accessories (cables, headset if any), and all 7 games present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete bundle/unknown contents (worst case: missing accessories and/or fewer games).

risks.risk: Condition risk: boxes may be fine but the actual items (if any) could be worn, scratched, or non-functional.
risks.proof: A power-on test clip showing the console booting to the home screen, controllers pairing, and one game launching.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not tested / worst case non-working until proven.

risks.risk: Authenticity risk: could be reprinted/repurposed boxes or counterfeit/modified items.
risks.proof: Photos of serial number label on the console, and close-ups of game disc labels/case barcodes (or receipts if available).
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest tier for unverified/possibly non-original items.

risks.risk: Exact game titles/editions affect value; witness text is not readable enough to confirm which games are included.
risks.proof: A photo list of the 7 games (titles visible) or a screenshot of the installed games/library if digital.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic/unknown games (worst case: lower-value titles).

proof_requests: Send clear photos of the actual PS4 console (front and back), including the serial number label.
Send photos of both controllers/pads and all accessories (power cable, HDMI, USB/cables, headset if any).
Send photos showing all 7 games clearly (titles visible on cases/discs) and confirm whether they are discs or digital.
Send a short power-on test video: console boots, controllers connect, and one game starts.
response.reason: The witness report shows only red printed board-game style boxes, while the seller claims a PS4 bundle with controllers and 7 games. Without proof of the PS4 and its contents, a worst-case price cannot be set reliably.
